title: reeva forever and always #evanoblezada #reevecarney #thegreatgatsby #...
transcript: Imagine having so much chemistry with your partner. You do not one not two but three shows on the West End / Broadway in just over a year. This is wild. Eva Noblezada is returning to The Great Gatsby on Broadway February 5th, and just under two months later, her husband Reeve Carney is joining the cast as Jay Gatsby. This casting is for me and me alone. I love them, but Reeva as the girlies call them, lore is actually pretty incredible. They met doing Hadestown in London in 2018 I think brought the show to Broadway, stayed with the show for a number of years. They then we're integral in bringing the original principal cast of Hadestown to London to film a pro shot. While they were in London reprising their roles in Hadestown, they got engaged, and it was announced they were going into cabaret together. Eva reprising her Sally Bowles role that she did on Broadway. Reeve going in as the Emcee I've heard incredible things. While they were in cabaret, they took, like, a couple days off, not enough time off. And they went to New Orleans and they got married. Returned to cabaret. This run ends January 24th which gives Eva two weeks to get back to New York and, I guess, rehearse and get back into Gatsby. She's starting back with Jeremy Jordan, reprising their og Broadway cast. Ryan Mccartan is then coming in, I believe March 7th for a Three week run and then Reeve joins her on the 30th. A win for us all if I do say so myself. I will definitely be in attendance, hopefully on the 30th.
